main_text.p:
Macte animi Ionstone via hac te ducet ad astra,
Diuumque mensis asferet.

Ne longum te turbet iter, nec tempora bellis
Vbique dura tristibus.

Ille erit, ille comes qui te vocat, i pede fausto
Quocunque te Deus iubet.

Hoc duce Sauromatas tutus, pictosq; Agathyrsos,
Propontidisque Bosphorum:

Indosque assiduis innise caloribus vstos
Inhospitalem & Caucasum.

Nec metue Oceani fluctus, ventosque furentes:
Et monstra Ponto quæ natant.

Auspicio quem Christe tuo comitaris euntem
Non oscines coruos timet,

Prægnantisq; canis, Parrhæ aut recinentis iniquū
Non horret omen obuium.

Quid? ridet portenta simul quæ Thuscus Aruspex
Vanique monstrant Augures.

page.notes: Printed ornament (fleuron) below the text, not transcribed. Some words in the first lines are set in an unusual typeface and read with some uncertainty (e.g. "Ionstone", "innise", "Indosque", "Macte"). Text printed as verse lines; the line breaks are within each stanza and have been kept as <lb/>.
